sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: While a Calling bond is Broken, you cannot use Calling cards associated with that bond or subtype.

sections.label: SCOPE
sections.html: Broken applies only to the affected bond. Your other Calling bonds and their cards remain usable.

sections.label: RECOVERY
sections.html: Broken is a lengthy failure state. It is normally repaired at the end of the Adventure or through an appropriate Recovery period.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
